name: Ble Midi → Send Raw
description: Sends MIDI bytes as they are: one complete message, a status byte followed by exactly the data bytes it needs. Use this for messages the other actions do not cover. A payload that is not a single complete message, or a System Exclusive message, is refused with a warning; use [`ble_midi.send_sysex`](https://esphome.io/components/ble_midi/#ble_midi-send_sysex-action) for those.
